instruments.name: Splendid Grand Piano
instruments.author: Alexander Holm
instruments.description: One of the most famous open-source concert grand pianos. Sample-mapped from a Yamaha C5 with 16 velocity layers per note, string resonance, and pedal noise. Delivers a rich, professional studio sound.

instruments.name: Maestro Concert Grand Piano
instruments.author: Mats Helgesson
instruments.description: A classical Yamaha CF-3 concert grand piano from the early 1990s. Features 5 velocity layers recorded via premium Neumann KM84 microphones, providing a deep, voluminous, and highly resonant sound stage.

instruments.name: Headroom Piano
instruments.author: Bengt Nilsson
instruments.description: A Yamaha C3 grand piano offering a versatile sound signature. It comes with 5 velocity layers and dual-microphone positions (Close Mics and an ambient Decca Tree configuration) adjustable directly via SFZ controls.

instruments.name: Old Piano FB
instruments.author: Roberto Gordo Saez
instruments.description: An authentic, vintage Francis Bacon upright piano recorded from the player's perspective. It has a charming honky-tonk character that fits perfectly in lo-fi, indie, jazz, and retro soundtrack productions.

instruments.name: Grand Piano K (Legacy)
instruments.author: Versilian Studios LLC
instruments.description: A legacy mapping of the grand piano K sample set from the Versilian Community collection, preserving vintage configuration presets.

instruments.name: Grand Piano K
instruments.author: Versilian Studios LLC
instruments.description: An authentic acoustic grand piano instrument featuring multi-velocity sampling and natural acoustic decays.

instruments.name: Grand Piano S Model B 1895
instruments.author: Versilian Studios LLC
instruments.description: A historic 1895 Steinway Model B grand piano, delivering a rich antique tone and unique mechanical resonance.

instruments.name: Harpsichord English (Keyswitch)
instruments.author: Versilian Studios LLC
instruments.description: An English harpsichord patch featuring standard key-switching to dynamically toggle between various registers and playing styles.

instruments.name: Harpsichord English (Lute)
instruments.author: Versilian Studios LLC
instruments.description: An English harpsichord configured to replicate the muted, delicate timbre of the traditional lute stop register.

instruments.name: Harpsichord English (Normal)
instruments.author: Versilian Studios LLC
instruments.description: The standard open-source English harpsichord patch capturing the bright, plucked harmonic definition of the full instrument.

instruments.name: Harpsichord Flemish 4'
instruments.author: Versilian Studios LLC
instruments.description: A Flemish harpsichord patch focused exclusively on the 4-foot register for bright, octave-higher harmonic content.

instruments.name: Harpsichord Flemish 8'
instruments.author: Versilian Studios LLC
instruments.description: A Flemish harpsichord patch mapped using the fundamental 8-foot register to provide standard baroque body and pitch definition.

instruments.name: Harpsichord Flemish (Full)
instruments.author: Versilian Studios LLC
instruments.description: The complete full-register mapping of the Flemish harpsichord for highly complex baroque music compositions.

instruments.name: Harpsichord Flemish (Keyswitch)
instruments.author: Versilian Studios LLC
instruments.description: A versatile Flemish harpsichord version allowing live articulation adjustments via dedicated MIDI keyswitches.

instruments.name: Harpsichord French
instruments.author: Versilian Studios LLC
instruments.description: A deeply resonant and classical French style harpsichord capturing the traditional plucked string tone architecture.

instruments.name: Harpsichord Italian
instruments.author: Versilian Studios LLC
instruments.description: An Italian harpsichord model delivering a snappy attack and rapid decays, ideal for energetic continuous basso continuo lines.

instruments.name: Harpsichord Unknown Model
instruments.author: Versilian Studios LLC
instruments.description: An alternative custom harpsichord model with unique mechanical and pluck characteristics.

instruments.name: Upright Piano Knight
instruments.author: Versilian Studios LLC
instruments.description: An intimate Knight upright piano patch, optimized for cozy, warm, and highly expressive acoustic tracking.

instruments.name: Upright Piano Y
instruments.author: Versilian Studios LLC
instruments.description: A vertical studio upright piano with a precise note attack and detailed release samples for realistic live performance tracking.
